ns2:course.label: The Legal Environment of Bus
ns2:course.description: (B ADM 200) Examination of the nature of law and the formation and application of legal principles; the role of law in society; the legal environment in which business operates, particularly government taxation; the regulation of commerce, competition, and labor-management relations; and the concept of property: its creation, transfer, and importance to our business society. Prerequisite: Juinor standing. Students taking CPA Exam need to register for Section 2.
